tithi_details.vishesh_mahatva: This is the first day of the lunar fortnight. It is ruled by Agni Dev and is highly auspicious for all types of new beginnings and prosperity rituals. The shape of the moon is a thin crescent.
Dwitiya is ruled by Brahma. It is a good day for beginning construction or laying foundations as it ensures structural longevity. It is also associated with Chandra (Moon).
This tithi is ruled by Vishnu. It is especially good for beauty, arts, and personal grooming. In some regions, it is associated with Goddess Gauri.
Chaturthi is dedicated to Lord Ganesha. The Shukla Paksha Chaturthi in Bhadrapada month is celebrated as Ganesh Chaturthi. It is powerful for removing obstacles.
Panchami is ruled by the Nag Devta. In Shukla Paksha of Magha month, it is celebrated as Vasant Panchami (Saraswati Puja). It is excellent for healing and medical interventions.
Shashthi is ruled by Kartikeya. It is considered very auspicious for fasting and winning over enemies. The famous Skanda Shashthi is observed on this day.
Saptami is dedicated to Surya Dev. The Shukla Saptami of Magha month is celebrated as Ratha Saptami. It is a very energetic day.

Ashtami is very powerful for Shakti worship. The Shukla Ashtami of Ashwin month is the famous Durga Ashtami (Maha Ashtami). It is not good for materialistic beginnings but excellent for spiritual gains.
Navami is ruled by Durga. The Shukla Navami of Chaitra month is celebrated as Ram Navami. This tithi grants victory and power.

shubh_karya: Worshipping Lord Yama for long life
tithi_details.vishesh_mahatva: Dashami is ruled by Yama. The Shukla Dashami of Ashwin is Vijayadashami (Dussehra), a day of victory of good over evil. It is good for starting a new career.

Ekadashi is the most beloved day of Lord Vishnu. All Ekadashis are highly sacred. It purifies the soul and helps in attaining Moksha. Fasting on this day is considered equivalent to performing 100 yagnas.
Dwadashi is ruled by Vishnu. The Shukla Dwadashi of Bhadrapada month is celebrated as Vamana Dwadashi. It is a day of nourishment and completing previous day's fast.
Trayodashi is ruled by Kamadeva. The Shukla Trayodashi of Chaitra month is celebrated as Mahavir Jayanti (Jainism). It is good for luxury and relationships.
Chaturdashi is ruled by Shiva. The Shukla Chaturdashi is considered very powerful for Shaivites. However, it is generally avoided for auspicious materialistic events as it is a fiery tithi.

Purnima is the most luminous day of the month. The full moon radiates positive energy. It is celebrated as Buddha Purnima, Guru Purnima, Sharad Purnima, and Kartik Purnima. It is highly auspicious for all religious activities.

shubh_karya: Starting new projects (if Purnima has passed)
tithi_details.vishesh_mahatva: Krishna Pratipada follows the Full Moon. The energy starts decreasing. It is neutral to mildly auspicious for daily tasks but not for major events.
Krishna Dwitiya is ruled by Vayu (Wind God). Good for physical strength, but material gains are moderate.
Krishna Tritiya is somewhat neutral. It is good for maintenance and repair work rather than new beginnings.
Krishna Chaturthi is celebrated as Sankashti Chaturthi. This is a very powerful day for Ganesha worship and removing life's obstacles. Moon sighting at night is mandatory to break the fast.
Krishna Panchami is good for medical sciences and healing. It is not considered auspicious for marriage.
Krishna Shashthi is good for protection of children (Bal Shashthi). It is a stable day for starting businesses.
Krishna Saptami is good for energy-related tasks. Buying a vehicle on this day is considered auspicious.

Krishna Ashtami in Bhadrapada month is celebrated as Janmashtami (birth of Lord Krishna). It is a dark, intense tithi, excellent for spiritual and tantric practices, but avoided for materialistic work.
Krishna Navami is good for aggressive actions and winning over opponents. It is ruled by Durga.
Krishna Dashami is ruled by Yama. It is good for spiritual discipline and charity. Not considered highly auspicious for marriage.
Krishna Ekadashi is equally sacred as Shukla Ekadashi. It is a day of complete devotion to Lord Vishnu. Fasting helps in purification of the soul and attainment of Vaikuntha.
Krishna Dwadashi is specifically important for breaking the Ekadashi fast. The Parana time must be calculated according to sunrise.

shubh_karya: Buying gold and property (in some regions)
tithi_details.vishesh_mahatva: Krishna Trayodashi is dedicated to Lord Shiva. The Pradosh Vrat falls on this day. It is considered highly auspicious for Shiva devotees.

Krishna Chaturdashi is observed as Masik Shivaratri (monthly Shivaratri). The Krishna Chaturdashi of Phalguna month is the great Maha Shivaratri. It is a night of intense spiritual practice and fasting.

Amavasya is the darkest night of the month. It is exclusively reserved for ancestors (Pitru). The Krishna Amavasya of Ashwin month is celebrated as Pitru Paksha Amavasya or Mahalaya. It is inauspicious for all new material beginnings, but highly powerful for spiritual cleansing and ancestral worship.
